sentences: Chlorhexidine is a disinfectant and antiseptic agent
It is a biguanide compound that is commonly used in various applications, including oral care, skin disinfection, and wound cleaning
Chlorhexidine is effective against a broad spectrum of microorganisms, including bacteria, viruses, and fungi
In oral care, chlorhexidine is often used as a mouthwash or gel to reduce plaque, gingivitis, and bad breath
It works by disrupting the cell membranes of microorganisms, ultimately leading to their death
Chlorhexidine is also used in skin disinfection and wound cleaning due to its ability to reduce bacterial load and promote wound healing
Chlorhexidine gluconate is the most commonly used form of chlorhexidine, which is available in various concentrations, including 0.12% and 2% solutions
The 0.12% solution is commonly used for oral care, while the 2% solution is used for skin disinfection and wound cleaning
